intro: This 15 day online breathing course (Pranayama) mixes prerecorded videos and daily live Zoom classes (1 hour each) with teachers from Rishikesh, India. You'll learn different breathing exercises and how to do them correctly, why each exercise works, and how to add these breathing practices to your daily life over 15 days.
In live classes, you can practice teaching friends or family. Stuck or confused? Ask the teachers directly during Zoom time.

issues: Unverified marketing stats on page not used: '★★★★★ (289 Ratings)', '4.8 Rating', '4500+ Students', '10+ Yoga Teachers', '10+ Lessons'.
Price conflict: this page shows $500; the listing /courses_group/online-yoga-course/ shows '$240' for the same course.
Hub /online-specialized-yoga-courses/ describes the corresponding course as '6 Days' (not 15 days).
Meta description calls this an 'Online Yoga Teacher Training course' — it is a 15-day specialised course, not a YTT.
Certification is from Himalayan Yoga Association (Rishikesh), not Bali Yoga School or Yoga Alliance.
Teacher bios on page are generic and shared across all 15-day online courses (Yogi Himanshu, Yogi Deepak, Yogi Pramod, Yogini Stuti) — names only extracted.
'Benefits of ...' list (Benefits of Pranayama) not extracted — generic benefits copy including health/medical claims.
Benefits list contains medical claims (e.g. reduces anxiety and depression, strengthens the immune system, lowers blood pressure) — must not be used.
Outline lists both 'Sitkari Pranayama' and 'Sheetkari' (same practice, two spellings).
